entities.summary: Douma or Duma is a city in Syria. Its centre is about 10 km (6 mi) northeast of the centre of Damascus. Being the capital of Rif Dimashq Governorate, the city is also the administrative centre of Douma District. Douma is a major city of the region known as Ghouta, for the peri-urban settlements to the east and south of Damascus. Douma is a big city. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
